records.subject: You're in -- let's get Pioneer Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Project created day 2 (fast start) but no invites, no replies to two outreach emails (email:42453073, email:2b32bc06), no tickets, and 6 days in with no key milestone. Team plan suggests real intent, but silence plus no_invite signals a single evaluator drifting; 8 days left gives moderate odds.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Following up on my note last week — you got your first project created, which is the main thing. Tasks live inside projects, so adding a few to that first one is usually the natural next step.

One thing I can help with: if you'd like other people from Pioneer Partners in there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Happy to walk through either on a short call this week — just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
